author: iblamedan
quote: GTA 6 has been a complete letdown. The story is terrible, the gameplay is underwhelming, and the overall experience is nowhere near what I expected after all the hype. On top of that, being unable to get more than 30 FPS makes the game feel like a slideshow rather than a next-gen experience. After years of waiting, this is genuinely disappointing. The graphics mean nothing if the story is boring and the performance is this poor. Rockstar seriously needs to do better. What a waste of expectations.
